notes:
POC is focused on embeddings + ANN index + cross-encoder rerank for top-5 quality. Customer wants aggressive ticket deflection to reduce agent load by 30%.

Key constraints: p99 latency target for end-to-end query (ann search + top-5 cross-encoder) <= 120ms, expected throughput ~200 QPS at peak, index scale 5-10M tickets, target cost per query <$0.02.

Current infra: Elastic for full-text, in-house embedder (CPU), sporadic rerank (slow). They are seeing poor top-5 relevance for short ticket texts and high per-query CPU cost for re-rank.

Security/legal: SOC2 in progress, require SSO/SAML integration, EU data residency for EU customers. Prefer VPC-dedicated deployment for production but open to a hosted path for faster go-live if SLA/pinning and residency can be satisfied.

Quotes from product/security: "If we can get <120ms p99 and keep cost under $0.02, we push to production Q3"; security: "need full audit trail + KMS for keys".

AE notes: prioritize fast rerank prototype (quantized cross-encoder on GPU + ANN pruned candidates) in POC. Upsell path: Dedicated reserved capacity + Optimize for batching/caching suggestions.

Stubs: POC design doc in Drive, security questionnaire in Drive, two recorded calls (Fireflies).

use_case_summary: Objective: deploy RAG-backed support agent to deflect tickets. Approach: index historical tickets + KB (5-10M docs), run ANN retrieval for candidates, apply cross-encoder rerank to return top-5. Success metrics: top-5 precision lift vs current baseline, p99 latency < 120ms, cost per query <$0.02. POC will validate embeddings model selection, ANN store config, and reranker latency on dedicated GPU pool.
